prompt: Research the solar, storage, and grid-flexibility reset as one bounded investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: After rate, inventory, and module-price pressure, electric-load growth and grid constraints may support selected solar, storage, electrification, and power-management survivors if project margins, financing, and cash conversion normalize. Track load growth, congestion, storage deployment and duration, residential financing rates, solar policy, module pricing, utility capital expenditure, and data-centre demand. Candidate value-chain exposures include modules and inverters, battery systems and optimization software, electrical equipment and conduit, power semiconductors, and fossil-generation substitutes or hedges. Confirmation requires normalized rates and inventories, healthy backlog conversion, accelerating grid capital expenditure, and share gains; invalidation includes persistent oversupply and pricing pressure, adverse policy or trade shifts, warranty or working-capital drains, and fossil alternatives remaining cheaper or faster.
